item.title: David Crowley wins messy Democratic primary for Wisconsin governor, defeating progressive Francesca Hong – live
item.summary: Polls had shown Hong as a clear frontrunner during the campaign, but with large chunks of voters still undecided and an ever-changing field of candidates, polling was difficult David Crowley wins Wisconsin Democratic primary for governor Sign up for the Breaking News US email Core inflation, which measures prices without volatile goods like food and gas, rose by 0.2% in July , after not really changing in June compared to the month prior. While the latest data shows there has been a 2.9% drop in gas prices from June to July, there has been a 25% hike compared to this time last year . Continue reading...
